C0683.title: Shanghai Jiading Chang Copyright Infringement Case Involving Pirated Film Works
C0683.summary: Chang in Jiading, Shanghai distributed more than 5.2 million film and television works or episodes, including Detective Chinatown 1900, through a website and profited through paid memberships. The court found the conduct constituted copyright infringement and sentenced Chang to two years and eight months in prison, suspended for two years and eight months, and imposed a 1.2 million yuan fine. The case was listed by the National Copyright Administration as a typical case in cinema film copyright protection work.
